_comment: NLM ISO journal-abbreviation lookups for the most commonly-cited biomedical journals. Keys are abbreviation (lowercased, no punctuation); values are the canonical full title (lowercased). Used by compare_metadata when journal-string equality and ISSN comparison both fail. Add more as needed.
n engl j med: the new england journal of medicine
ca cancer j clin: ca: a cancer journal for clinicians
j am coll cardiol: journal of the american college of cardiology
proc natl acad sci u s a: proceedings of the national academy of sciences of the united states of america
pnas: proceedings of the national academy of sciences of the united states of america
